findings.description: Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-01 (expired IME). Document narrative explicitly states IME completed 2024-03-10, exceeds 12-month validity, expired 2025-03-10, new exam required. Worker emitted only generic 'exam required, subject to exemption' boilerplate and detected zero defects.
Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-01 (expired IME, scanned sibling). Narrative states 12-month validity exceeded / expired. Worker produced identical boilerplate, no expiry detection, no defect claim.

Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-02 (non-designated physician). Narrative explicitly states Dr. Alan Miller (UNREGISTERED-999) is not a designated panel physician and Sunrise Family General Practice not authorized. Worker missed it entirely with generic boilerplate.
Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-02 (non-designated physician, scanned sibling). Narrative flags unregistered physician/unauthorized clinic. Worker emitted identical generic claim, zero defect detection.

Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-03 (unresolved furtherance). Narrative states abnormal chest X-ray (apical scarring), pending pulmonology report and sputum culture, furtherance unresolved. Worker detected nothing; boilerplate only.

Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-03 (unresolved furtherance, scanned sibling). Narrative states incomplete assessment with pending specialist/lab results. Worker missed the defect with identical generic output.

Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-04 (missing upfront proof). Narrative explicitly states file lacks proof of upfront exam, no IMM1017B form or eMedical receipt attachment. Worker missed the completeness defect entirely.
Ground truth PFL-MEDICAL_-04 (missing upfront proof, scanned sibling). Narrative states missing IMM1017B/eMedical receipt. Worker produced identical boilerplate, no defect claim.

Worker output is non-responsive across all 10 cases: an identical, verbatim generic claim citing the corpus exemption, with no extraction or validation of document fields (ime_number, examination_date, panel_physician_id, furtherance_status, imm1017b/eMedical receipt). No invented facts (grounding not violated), but the report never engages the attached document, so it neither confirms clean cases nor surfaces defective ones.

Clean case (meets_requirements). Worker did not falsely flag a defect (correctly no false positive), but also failed to extract/affirm the passing exam fields; single generic claim identical to all defective cases, providing no document-specific verification value.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Require the agent to parse and validate the eMedical sheet's structured fields AND the 'Narrative Statements / Detailed Notes' block, then emit a per-document verdict. Add mandatory checks: (1) examination_date within 12-month validity vs current processing date (PFL-01); (2) panel_physician_id/clinic against designated-panel status, flagging 'UNREGISTERED'/'not a designated panel physician' language (PFL-02); (3) furtherance_status resolved and specialist/lab results present, flagging 'furtherance required/pending/unresolved' (PFL-03); (4) presence of imm1017b_form and eMedical receipt/attachment, flagging 'lacks proof'/'no IMM1017B' (PFL-04). Each failed check MUST produce a distinct defect claim, not a generic requirement statement.

Prohibit emitting identical, document-agnostic boilerplate claims. Every report must ground claims in the specific attached document's fields/narrative and answer the completeness/defect question, not merely restate the general medical-exam requirement. If the document narrative explicitly asserts a deficiency, the agent must surface it as a defect claim rather than defaulting to 'exam required, subject to exemption'.

rationale: The Worker (gemini-3.6-flash) returned a near-verbatim, generic report for all 10 cases: a single claim that an IME is required subject to the corpus exemption, citing medical/requirements-permanent-residents.md#000. It never read document fields or the explicit narrative statements. Consequently it detected 0/8 injected defects (PFL-01 expired IME, PFL-02 non-designated physician, PFL-03 unresolved furtherance, PFL-04 missing upfront proof) even though each defect was stated in plain language in the PDF narrative — defect_recall=0.0 for all 8 defective cases. The 2 clean cases score defect_recall=1.0 (no defects existed, none falsely reported). PII containment and blind-input compliance are perfect: no applicant names/DOB/IDs leaked into claims/prose (basis[] holds only opaque case IDs and slot type), and no ground-truth leakage. Grounding_accuracy (0.9) and citation_exactness (0.9) remain high because the lone claim invents no facts and the corpus citation is consistent and plausible — but the reports are wholly non-responsive to the document-review task. The dominant, critical failure is complete absence of document engagement and defect detection.
